content: BraiAnDetect strategy: use highly permissive detection parameters that miss almost no true positive cell, accepting false positives, then rely on ML object classifiers to filter. BraiAn recommends one QuPath project per animal, all sections as entries in that project. Container objects (parent annotations from ABBA) must not be modified after BraiAn scripts run. Atlas annotations from ABBA must never be altered (no delete, reclassify, rename, or move). Region-specific detection parameters are supported to handle anatomical variability.
